text:
kevin: hi team! first morning here :) quick operational q: wheres the best place to post onboarding docs + receipts for hardware reimbursements? also which channels should i keep loud/quiet so i don't drown in noise?

tara: welcome @kevin! post onboarding docs in #new-hires (root message) and attach receipts there too. People Ops (cc @julie) will pick them up. For hardware reimbursements, include the invoice and tag @it-support.

kevin: nice. about channels  which ones are "must-subscribe" vs optional?

tara: musts: #announcements (company-wide), your team channel (e.g., #eng-platform), and #people-ops for onboarding updates. opt-ins: #release-notifs, #eng-infra, #random. Set noisy ones to "mentions only".

it-support: To submit a reimbursement: upload in #new-hires -> add `Reimburse: <amount>` in the thread and DM @it-support with your employee id. For lost hardware, open a ticket with subject "Hardware lost - <name>" and CC @people-ops.

kevin: good to know. i see a bunch of bot pings in #eng-releases. how do i make sure i get only the alerts relevant to my services?

devops-bot: Bot tip: in #release-notifs run `@releases subscribe team=<team-slug>` or `@releases subscribe repo=org/repo`. For infra alerts, run `@devops-bot filter set team=<team-slug> severity>=warning`. If unsure, DM @devops-bot `help`.

kevin: ok thanks. any etiquette rules for threads vs dms vs channel pings? don't want to be "that" new person. :grimacing:

tara: short rules: threads for follow-ups to keep channels tidy, DMs for private info or 1:1s, @channel only for true team-wide urgent msgs (rare). React instead of posting "thanks" whenever possible. If you're asking a question that might be useful later, post in channel and summarize in the thread for future readers.

kevin: love the react rule. how do i opt into onboarding reminders or 30/60/90 check-ins?

onboard-bot: Use `@onboard-bot subscribe cadence=30d` in this thread or DM `@onboard-bot prefs` to configure. Julie can also set calendar invites if you prefer manual scheduling.

julie: @kevin i can do calendar invites and confirm reimbursements once you post the receipts. one small onboarding preference: please keep checklist updates as thread replies (not new posts) so we can mark completion easily.

kevin: posting checklist + receipt now. also muted #random already :sweat_smile: thanks everyone!

onboard-bot: Thanks @kevin  checklist received. People Ops will respond in-thread within 24 hours if anything's missing.
